svg.text: Employee ID Card Generator — the twelve templates

Every face below is the engine's own SVG output at 1011 × 638 px (ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1 at 300 dpi) with one sample employee and one palette. The QR tiles are left empty here; panel 13 shows one card at full detail.

svg.title: corporate-split front
svg.text: If found, please return to CloudHost247 Ltd

g.text: 13. Modern Badge with the real QR symbol and Code 128 barcode
The QR is a module group that publishes its own payload; the barcode is drawn only when its narrowest bar stays at least 0.19 mm wide at 300 dpi.
